name: scm
description: SCM: local-first photo & video search (vision, scenes, OCR, dialogue)
author: Allen Lee

scripts.test:ask: node test/ask-models.test.js && node test/ask-retrieve.test.js && node test/ask-server.test.js && bun test test/ask-scope.test.ts
scripts.smoke:ask: bash -c 'TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/scm-ask-XXXX) && ln -s "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/models" "$TMP/models" 2>/dev/null || true; ELECTRON_SMOKE_ASK=1 MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP electron .'
scripts.smoke:cto: bash -c 'TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/scm-cto-XXXX) && ln -s "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/models" "$TMP/models" 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p "$TMP/ocr-data"; for f in "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/ocr-data"/*.traineddata; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; ln -s "$f" "$TMP/ocr-data/"; done; MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_SMOKE_CTO=1 electron .'
scripts.test:cto: bash -c 'TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/scm-cto-XXXX) && ln -s "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/models" "$TMP/models" 2>/dev/null || true; MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_SMOKE_CTO=1 electron .'
scripts.smoke:phase4: bash -c 'TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/scm-phase4-XXXX) && ln -s "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/models" "$TMP/models" && mkdir -p "$TMP/ocr-data" && for f in "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/ocr-data"/*.traineddata; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; ln -s "$f" "$TMP/ocr-data/"; done; MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_SMOKE_PHASE4=1 electron .'
scripts.smoke:deep: bash -c 'TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/scm-deep-XXXX) && ln -s "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/models" "$TMP/models" && mkdir -p "$TMP/ocr-data" && for f in "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/ocr-data"/*.traineddata; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; ln -s "$f" "$TMP/ocr-data/"; done; MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_SMOKE_DEEP=1 electron .'
scripts.smoke:perf: bash -c 'TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/scm-perf-XXXX) && ln -s "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/models" "$TMP/models" && mkdir -p "$TMP/ocr-data" && for f in "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/ocr-data"/*.traineddata; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; ln -s "$f" "$TMP/ocr-data/"; done; MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_SMOKE_PERF=1 electron .'
scripts.smoke:grid: bun run build && bash -c 'TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/scm-grid-XXXX) && ln -s "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/models" "$TMP/models" 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p "$TMP/ocr-data"; for f in "$HOME/Library/Application Support/scm/ocr-data"/*.traineddata; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; ln -s "$f" "$TMP/ocr-data/"; done; MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP node scripts/perf-grid-fixture.js && MEMORIES_DATA_DIR=$TMP ELECTRON_SMOKE=1 ELECTRON_SMOKE_GRID=1 electron .'
